summary_markdown:
A database connectivity issue was reported when extracting dictionaries from PostgreSQL using ClickHouse. The specific error encountered was an 'out of memory' failure (Code: 1001) during a query execution.

Discussion followed regarding the possibility of using a native PostgreSQL engine connection method for dictionary extraction, referencing a previously implemented feature for ClickHouse.
action_items: Investigate using a native PostgreSQL engine connection for dictionary extraction.
